name: Wasp_Connection From Direction
brief: Wasp_Connection From Direction | Inputs: GEO, CEN, UP, T → CONN, PLN_OUT
context: Wasp plugin component: creates connection objects from part geometry, center points, and X-axis direction curves. Z direction determined from geometry normals. Connection IDs assigned sequentially (0-based) by input order. These IDs are referenced by Wasp_Rule.
solution_principle: Create connections on part geometry from center points and X-axis direction. Z direction is inferred from geometry normals. Each input point creates one WaspConnection with a sequential 0-based ID. These IDs are what Wasp_Rule references. Feed the same Brep to both this component's GEO and Wasp_Basic Part's GEO.
anti_patterns: Do not reorder input points after rules are defined â€” connection IDs will shift and silently break rules
preconditions: Part geometry (Brep or Mesh) must be available
Center points positioned at connection face centers
